SRC-199 has exactly two fixed historical response witnesses, copied byte for
byte from the retained steering evidence. a.md is SAITULS T-273, SHA256
1378f149861acd5a345e16c97b0b0a863b667aecd054a3b8a728d1227fe6ed15.

The original per-session human transcripts and installed host generations are
not captured. SRC-199 records the operator's report of the requested diagnosis;
its provenance remains model_supplied. Test request carriers are explicit
disposable doubles, not historical operator approvals or production grants.
The separate FastPrompter/SAIFREN session is not a witness.

The regression compares the authenticated previous response_surface.py with
the changed owner under the same test, command, input, fixture and assumptions.
Non-operational diagnosis requests are tested; this is not a replay of an
uncaptured FreeBuff native host call. Valid records check citation binding and
disclose required semantic review. The independent evidence analysis must
separately judge relevance, rule applicability and claimed behavior.
